jobs.description_text: About Us: Founded in early 2021, Ibility is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business and a Woman-Owned Small Business, headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD. Ibility is a small but mighty company that is positioned for rapid growth. Simply put, we help government leaders to achieve their mission by designing creative products and programs that delight their customers and make their employees more efficient - building trust and improving overall satisfaction. We use human-centered design principles in every engagement because we believe the end-user is critical to the long-term success of any solution. Our team is fun, passionate, bold, and creative. We live our mission every day – to inspire people, create cool stuff, and make a lasting impact on the world! Job Summary: The Specialty Branch Support Analyst receives, reviews, and processes Specialty Branch packets in support of the Ohio National Guard’s accessions and commissioning process. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (US, West)
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. jobs.title: OSINT Analyst - Vessel Identification
jobs.description_text: Automated detection can find vessels, but cannot always tell you which vessel it is. When a contact appears in a satellite image with no matching AIS, when an identity has been spoofed or duplicated, when a name and IMO do not agree, or when the models simply return low confidence, a human analyst has to resolve it. As an OSINT Analyst on Kpler's Maritime Domain Awareness team, you are the adjudication layer behind the machine. You take the detections that automated identification cannot confidently resolve and attach an identity to them: name, IMO, owner, operator, and flag, with the evidence and the confidence to stand behind it. You investigate dark vessels, AIS gaps, GNSS spoofing, and identity manipulation, and you reconstruct the ownership and behaviour that explains what a vessel is really doing. Your work does two things at once. It makes Kpler's unified vessel record more complete and more trusted for the analysts, compliance desks, and government users who depend on it. And it creates the labelled ground truth that makes the detection models better, so the routine cases keep shrinking and human attention stays on the genuinely hard ones.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead - Radio Intelligent Controller Systems
jobs.description_text: Parallel Wireless is reimagining mobile networks with innovative, energy-efficient Open RAN solutions. Join us as we lead the future of telecommunications, driving innovation through green and sustainable networks. Learn more about our mission, vision and values. We are looking for a Senior Technical Lead who is comfortable operating across the entire system, from low-level Linux and networking problems to the architecture of large Go and Kubernetes-based distributed systems. This role is for someone who can investigate a Linux kernel or networking issue in the morning, review a concurrency problem in Go before lunch, design a multi-service distributed flow in the afternoon, and help debug a C++ component when production behavior does not match expectations. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every technology we use. You do need the technical range, curiosity, and systems thinking to move between layers quickly and understand how they affect one another. Our team owns RIC Systems end to end, including Near-RT RIC, Non-RT RIC, infrastructure, messaging, state management, network-facing components, microservices, deployment, performance, reliability, and production troubleshooting. We are looking for someone who wants that breadth.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role, combining architecture, coding, technical leadership, and mentorship. You will work from our Kfar Saba site alongside RAN, PHY, and software teams, building production-grade AI solutions for real cellular networks.

jobs.title: Commercial Analyst
jobs.description_text: About Octopus Electroverse We’re making electric vehicle public charging simple by building the giant, virtual charging platform of the future. In just five years, Octopus Electroverse has grown to become Europe’s largest eMSP public charging network, with over 1.4 million connected electric vehicle chargers globally across 79 countries. Naturally, we’re now taking this success beyond individual consumer drivers and scaling our dedicated B2B proposition - Octopus Fleet - to help businesses transition to zero-emission transport with ease. From EV public charging cards to home charging reimbursement, we are building the ultimate all-in-one suite to simplify fleet electrification. Electroverse and Octopus Fleet operate as a unified, cross-functional team across product, commercial, operations, marketing, and partnerships - all sharing a passion for shifting the industry toward EVs. As our commercial pipeline expands across high-value enterprise deals and complex formal tenders, we are looking for a sharp, structured, and analytical individual to build out and professionalise our bid engine. Reporting into the Commercial Strategy Manager, your focus will be on transitioning our tender process from a decentralised team effort into a streamlined, high-winning commercial capability.

jobs.description_text: Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. We now serve over 12 million customers globally, are present in over 30 countries and manage a £7 billion portfolio of renewable energy assets. At Octopus, we prioritise generalists over specialists because our growth isn't limited to just one sector. We built Kraken into a £10B SaaS powerhouse, and are scaling ventures across Tech, Flexibility and Smart Heating among others. We are now looking to take our experience to new countries around the world. We are looking for someone to lead the build out forecasting and asset optimisation analytics in a new market for Octopus in East Asia. The role will cover forecasting price, generation and demand outturns. This will start off with a contained number of pilot projects to prove out the concept, but will expand to a national, multi-province approach. jobs.description_text: Digital Marketing Manager｜Job Description About You（求める人物像） 日本市場におけるデジタルマーケティング戦略の企画・実行をリードするポジションです。 Webサイト、SEO、コンテンツマーケティング、デジタル広告、メールマーケティング、マーケティングオートメーション、SNSなどのデジタルチャネルを活用し、ブランド認知の向上、リード獲得、顧客エンゲージメント、パイプライン創出につなげていきます。また、他チームと連携し、日本市場のビジネス目標に合わせた統合的なデジタルマーケティング施策を推進します。戦略立案だけでなく、キャンペーンの企画・実行、コンテンツ制作・管理、Hands-onで一貫して担当できる方を求めています。 ABOUT US（会社概要） Xsolla（エクソラ）は、ビデオゲーム業界が抱えるさまざまな課題を解決するために設計された、強力なツールとサービスを提供するグローバルなコマース企業です。インディーからAAAタイトルまで、あらゆる規模の開発会社が、資金調達、配信、マーケティング、マネタイズにおいてXsollaと提携しています。「ゲームの未来を信じる」という理念のもと、Xsollaは、ゲーム開発者により多くの機会とリソースを提供し続けることを使命としています。本社は米国カリフォルニア州ロサンゼルスにあり、商取引の記録管理を担う企業（Merchant of Record）として、これまでに1,500社以上のゲーム開発者が、より多くのプレイヤーにリーチし、ビジネスの成長を実現するサポートを行ってきました。Xsollaは、収益化の多様な選択肢と成功への道筋を提供し、開発者が“ゲームを楽しむ”ために必要なすべてを支援しています。詳しくはhttps://www.xsolla.com をご覧ください。

jobs.title: Partner Success Manager, China & APAC
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Partner Success Manager to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) Business Development team, based in China. This is a newly created, hybrid role sitting within the core XPN BD team — roughly 80% campaign and partner success, 20% business development support — created to close a gap in how XPN partners are supported once a deal closes: campaigns are launched, but no one consistently owns their ongoing success. The best candidate will be someone comfortable owning outcomes rather than just relationships — proactively strategizing with partners, coordinating across internal teams to get campaigns right, and stepping in to help close deals when local presence and trust matter more than a remote pitch. Full ownership of the sales process (sourcing, pitching, commercial negotiation) sits with the Core China/APAC Team; this role isn't required to run a deal end-to-end, but is expected to help get opportunities over the line and make sure they deliver once signed. If you're excited about building a new function from the ground up, becoming a product expert partners and internal teams rely on, and working across both Chinese and global creator platforms as publishers look to expand their reach, we would love to hear from you! jobs.title: PhD - Inverse modal identification of free-field radiated noise from unducted rotor-stator stages: from laboratory arrays to Open Fan flight tests
jobs.description_text: Context: This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources. Objective: To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size). Description: Task 1 – Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations. Task 2 – Validation on the MAMBO database.
